patches.note: window.__gtbgReduceMotion (prefers-reduced-motion, live) read by J2/J3. Dialog helpers (window.* and document.*: the Help chunk only has `document` as a baseline global): __gtbgDlg = ref callback of a MODAL dialog (focus in on mount, Tab/Shift+Tab trap, a document focusin guard pulls stray focus back, Esc clicks the dialog's own Close button and stops there, focus back to the element that opened it once the dialog is gone); __gtbgPanel = the same without trap/Esc for non-modal panels; __gtbgRow / __gtbgList = keyboard model of click-only lists (the list is ONE tab stop, ArrowDown/Home/End or Enter on it reach the rows, rows take Arrow/Home/End/Enter/Space, typing returns to the search field, keys are stopped so the group-A shortcut guard never sees Space/letters meant for the list); __gtbgFocusId = focus an element that is about to render

class hook: the shim hides this duplicate of the timeline clock below 1280 px so the header still fits
class hook (narrow-desktop compaction)
